title: SSN: Shift Suppression Network for Endogenous Shift of Photovoltaic Defect Detection
mechanism: Background style suppression module aligns channel statistics during training to remove background style shift without target-domain data.
adaptation: Insert a BSS-style instance-statistics alignment (with style mixing across our 5 sources) into ResNet layer1-2 of the PF model, aiming at E1 contrast and scuff-streak shift.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + BSS in layer1-2. Baseline: PF, 5 seeds. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2; leave-one-source-out crack IoU on val folds. Kill if E1 relF1@2 < +0.03.
evidence: R: 16,323 EL images collected at three different times; SSN beats SOTA detectors under endogenous shift (detection, numbers not retrieved).
prior_overlap: Test-time per-panel BN adaptation and intensity normalisation failed; train-time style statistics suppression not tested. Open.
